title: Élet három határon (Life Across Three Borders)
grammar: szokott → szokás volt: Customs of the Past

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe the daily life, skirmishes (portya), and single combat (bajvívás) of border warriors.
I can explain how market towns (mezővárosok) thrived through the western cattle trade.
I can describe historical customs using habitual expressions like szokás volt.
I can use the new words about border fortresses and trade routes.
